jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.fitNotes: Real JD is explicitly early-career: "you don't need deep expertise across all three areas" (IAM, AI, cloud), security experience is "a plus, not a requirement," and you'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with senior engineers learning modern security practices with room to specialize. Directly mirrors your #1 KPMG calibration benchmark - a cloud/IAM security ops blend. Fully remote, pay above floor, no red flags in the real JD.

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.fitNotes: Real JD confirms 2-4 yrs Azure cloud engineering with your exact AZ-900 cert listed as a qualification, plus junior-friendly "willingness to learn and grow" framing around Azure App Services, DevOps/CI-CD, and security best practices. Direct hire (healthcare tech), Phoenix on-site, pay well above floor - strong core-skills and trajectory match.

jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.fitNotes: Direct title match, hands-on infrastructure engineering - builds toward Solutions Architect trajectory. Direct hire, solidly above pay floor. Pay level is in line with the title, no red flag.

jobs.title: Cloud Network Engineer - Delivery Senior Consultant, Infrastructure Engineering Solutions
jobs.fitNotes: Internal Deloitte transfer to a hands-on network/infrastructure engineering team - strong trajectory move plus known environment.

jobs.title: Associate, Cyber Operations, Cloud Security
jobs.fitNotes: Matches your #1 calibration benchmark exactly - CSPM/CNAPP-style cloud security ops. Strong skills match (IAM/cloud analysis) and advances the cloud security specialization path toward Solutions Architect.

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.fitNotes: Real JD requires only 1+ year of IT experience with cloud exposure; Terraform/CloudFormation, Docker/Kubernetes, and cloud certs are framed as "familiarity" or "relevant," not hard requirements - a realistic stretch that builds the hands-on IaC portfolio you're closing. Caveat: supports government clients and requires ability to obtain a Public Trust/clearance (not one already held), and pay could land at the low end of the wide range.

jobs.title: AWS IAM Engineer
jobs.fitNotes: Real JD (pulled directly from Capgemini's careers site) is hands-on AWS IAM engineering - building IAM roles/policies, migrating CloudFormation to Terraform, integrating with Identity Governance platforms - a strong match to your IAM/multi-cloud background and a direct way to build real Terraform experience. No explicit years-of-experience gate stated, though it's banded "Experienced Professionals" so may want a bit more than 3 years; not a hard senior/staff stretch like other AWS IAM roles found tonight.

jobs.title: Associate Platform Engineer - Cloud Native
jobs.fitNotes: Real JD is explicitly early-career ("motivated early-career engineer," "prior [Kubernetes] experience not required"), with hands-on Terraform/Ansible/Kubernetes learning built into the role at a well-funded ($3.5B valuation) cloud infrastructure company - directly builds the IaC portfolio you're closing. Caveat: pay range ($80k-$90k) sits at or just under your $85k floor.

jobs.title: Exposure Intelligence Analyst - Cloud Platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP/Cloud Posture)
jobs.fitNotes: Real JD sets a realistic 3+ yrs cloud security/engineering bar with any major cloud provider - this is CSPM/cloud-posture and cloud IAM work, closely mirroring your #1 KPMG calibration benchmark. Caveat: internal "Lead Consultant/SME" job-architecture banding suggests more ownership scope than a pure associate role, worth probing in the interview. Pay well above floor.

jobs.title: Cloud DevOps Analyst
jobs.fitNotes: Real JD is an explicitly mentored, growth-oriented role ("serves as second to our Cloud Architect") requiring only 1-3 yrs IT/cloud experience, with Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes, and Azure Pipelines framed as "functional knowledge of, or a strong desire to learn" rather than hard requirements - directly builds the hands-on Terraform/IaC experience you're closing. Caveat: pay not listed, confirm floor before applying.

jobs.title: Jr DevOps Engineer
jobs.fitNotes: Real JD is an explicitly early-career DevOps role ("operates under the guidance of senior engineers," 1-3 yrs required) building real hands-on AWS + Terraform + CI/CD experience, directly matching your portfolio-building goal. Caveat: JD states starting salaries are typically placed in the lower half of the range, so there's real risk it lands below your $85k floor - worth a pay-expectations check before applying.
